test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In triangle ABC, the bisector of angle A meets side BC at point D. If AB = 28 cm, AC = 42 cm, and BC = 50 cm, find the length of BD.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle Bisector Theorem: The bisector of an angle divides the opposite side in the ratio of the other two sides.

Ratio BD : DC = AB : AC = 28 : 42 = 2 : 3

Total parts = 2 + 3 = 5 units

Given 5 units = 50 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 10 cm

BD = 2 units = 2 × 10 = 20 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In ΔABC, AB = 28 cm, AC = 42 cm, BC = 50 cm.

AD is the internal angle bisector of ∠A meeting BC at D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2b8b519e2e52b9ff505f366bce76f06eb7f989411b591cada07d8eddab07b15.png] 

According to the Internal Angle Bisector Theorem:

⇒ BD / DC = AB / AC

Let BD = x cm, then DC = (50 − x) cm

⇒ x / (50 − x) = 28 / 42

⇒ x / (50 − x) = 2 / 3

⇒ 3 × x = 2 × (50 − x)

⇒ 3x = 100 − 2x

⇒ 5x = 100

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Internal Angle Bisector Theorem

The internal bisector of an angle of a triangle divides the opposite side internally in the ratio of the corresponding sides: BD/DC = AB/AC.

Length of Angle Bisector

The length of the internal bisector AD is given by AD² = (AB × AC) − (BD × DC). For this triangle, AD = √(28 × 42 − 20 × 30) = √576 = 24 cm.

External Angle Bisector Theorem

If AD' is the external bisector of ∠A meeting BC produced at D', then BD'/CD' = AB/AC.
